about_the_game:
Complete different missions, with various objectives, from legendary contracts, in which you will find different challenges. Invade, steal and destroy different locations.
Each contract will bring a unique experience, where you will have to think of a strategy to complete it. In addition, each contract will bring a different scenery, with new mechanics available to be used.
Execute the contracts in your way, selecting what you want to do, without a predetermined order. Have freedom to choose!



The Fhyp army, commanded by Mikael - "The tyrant", is trying to seize power in a country, with that the stocks on the exchange are plummeting, in addition to having a high risk of civil war in the country, this risk being caused by the growing domination of Mikael's army. Thus, with no possible means to stop the Fhyp paramilitaries, a conglomerate of national companies hires BlueContracts, a company specialized in high-level obscure contracts, which ends up elaborating a specialized plan to decimate the chances of the Fhyp army seize power and consequently to continue its operations.
In this way, Luk, an expert shooter from BlueContracts, will face the Fhyp army through the contracts made by the conglomerate of companies, executing the plan elaborated by BlueContracts.


To execute the contracts you'll have different weapons, which you'll be able to select before starting each contract, the way you want and find it convenient.
You can use rifles, snipers, pistols and grenades. In addition to a range of customizations for your weapons.
Some weaponry and accessories can be found and unlocked while executing contracts.



Execute contracts in stealth mode or arrive smashing. Kill army commanders, set barracks on fire, intercept signals, distract enemies, disguise yourself, blend in, and much more!
You will have to execute 8 contracts in total. Each contract will bring a unique experience, with its specificities and difficulties.



Explore the scenarios and find secret items, easter eggs and collectibles. You will receive prizes when you find some secret collectibles.


Feel free to reach each goal by exploring the scenarios however you like!
Play and feel the power of freedom and strategy together with the feeling of action, experience this magnificent experience in Contractor.
